subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Utilizar pistas linguísticas – tais como “em primeiro/segundo/terceiro lugar”, “por outro lado”, “dito de outro modo”, isto é”, “por exemplo” – para compreender a hierarquização das proposições, sintetizando o conteúdo dos textos.

components.description_pt: Identificar pistas linguísticas que sinalizam relações hierárquicas ou lógicas entre proposições
components.description_en: Identify linguistic cues that signal hierarchical or logical relationships between propositions in a text
components.cc_component_description: Identify transitions that signal relationships among ideas in informational writing

components.description_pt: Usar expressões conectivas para compreender estrutura organizacional de texto expositivo ou argumentativo
components.description_en: Use connective expressions to understand the organizational structure of an expository or argumentative text
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the organizational structure an author uses in an exposition or argument

components.description_pt: Sintetizar conteúdo principal reconhecendo relações sinalizadas por marcadores discursivos
components.description_en: Synthesize the main content of a text by recognizing the relationships signaled by discourse markers
components.cc_component_description: Synthesize the central ideas of an informational piece in a coherent concluding section

cc_matches.description: Analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of the structure an author uses in his or her exposition or argument, including whether the structure makes points clear, convincing, and engaging.
Provide a concluding statement or section that follows from and supports the information or explanation presented (e.g., articulating implications or the significance of the topic).
Use appropriate and varied transitions to create cohesion and clarify the relationships among ideas and concepts.
